title: Applied Scientist I, CMT
description:
**Description**
As a member of the CMT team, you'll play a key role in the evolution of our Competitive Monitoring systems to solve significantly complex and interesting technical challenges in machine learning, large language models in production, and recommender systems to name a few. The team's work directly impacts customer experience at a worldwide scale.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Research the problem domain and come up with various approaches to solve the problem.
* Be willing to experiment quickly and fail fast.
* Collaborate with engineers to come up with the right end to end solution to the business problems.
* Ideate on future roadmap for science in CMT
* Be willing to roll up your sleeves and learn core topics outside applied science, for example ML engineering

A day in the life
  
  
A typical day might involve (a) working on ideas for improving models around product similarity or price recommendations, (b) working closely with other scientists and our ML engineers to ensure that the best models are in production, (c) writing good maintainable code that can be reused and reproduced, (d) sharing your work across CMT and beyond via technical writings and presentations
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience programming in Java, C++, Python or related language
* Experience with SQL and an RDBMS (e.g., Oracle) or Data Warehouse

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience implementing algorithms using both toolkits and self-developed code

title: Analyst, Algorithm Research & Development
description:
To make electronics, you need chips, wafers, transistors, reticles, and... To make these, you must see, test and manufacture them at scale—faster and better than ever before. That's where KLA comes in. Whether you're early in your career or an experienced professional, you'll solve complex challenges, work alongside brilliant minds and help shape the future of technology.
  
  
**Group/Division**
The Semiconductor Products and Customers (Semi PC) business unit designs, builds and sells KLA’s product portfolio to help chip manufacturers meet high-quality standards for technologies like AI, data centers, automotive and electronic devices. Our inspection, metrology, and analytics systems detect and monitor defects across logic and memory chips, specialty semiconductors, wafers, reticles, advanced packaging, process equipment and materials. We also develop technologies for specialty processes, IC substrates, and PCB manufacturing, including etch and deposition, component inspection, and imaging and analytics. The Measurement, Analytics and Control (MACH) division is KLA’s software powerhouse, responsible for developing high-performance software platforms that support semiconductor manufacturing. MACH delivers cutting-edge technologies in patterning analytics, modeling, and data science—empowering chipmakers to ramp next-gen devices faster and more efficiently. Our cross-functional team of research scientists, software engineers, apps engineers and process engineers are solving the industry’s most complex technical problems.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
In this role, you will play a key part in advancing business priorities by delivering high-impact work across your area of expertise.
  
  
**About The Role**
We are seeking an intellectually curious and technically exceptional AI Engineer to join our Applied AI Research organization.
  
  
This role is designed for individuals who enjoy moving beyond application of established techniques and are motivated by solving problems that have no obvious solution. The successful candidate will combine strong software engineering fundamentals with expertise in machine learning, statistical algorithms, deep learning, and agentic AI systems to create next-generation intelligence platforms for semiconductor manufacturing and engineering.
  
  
Unlike traditional software engineering roles, this position requires a strong research mindset. We are looking for engineers who question assumptions, derive first-principles understanding of problems, conduct systematic experimentation, and translate emerging research into practical business impact.
  
  
This role offers a unique opportunity to grow into a future technical and research leader capable of influencing the direction of AI, analytics, and intelligent automation across the organization.
  
  
**Vision for the Role**
Over the next several years, this individual is expected to evolve from an AI engineer into a recognized research leader who:
  
  

* Shapes the organization's AI strategy through technical innovation.
* Drives a culture of experimentation and evidence-based decision making.
* Bridges cutting-edge AI research with real-world engineering applications.
* Identifies transformational technologies before they become mainstream.
* Inspires teams to pursue ambitious technical challenges.
* Builds an innovation ecosystem through mentorship, technical leadership, and collaboration.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Applied AI Research**

* Investigate emerging AI techniques and evaluate their applicability to semiconductor manufacturing and engineering workflows.
* Conduct hands-on research in areas such as:

+ Foundation Models
+ Agentic AI Systems
+ Scientific Machine Learning
+ Computer Vision
+ Reinforcement Learning
+ Probabilistic Modeling
+ Knowledge Representation
+ Multi-Agent Systems
+ Causal AI

* Develop novel approaches for solving difficult engineering and manufacturing problems.
* Design rigorous experimental frameworks to validate hypotheses and quantify impact.
* Translate research findings into scalable product capabilities.

**Statistical Learning & Algorithm Development**
Design and develop advanced algorithms utilizing:
  
  

* Bayesian Inference
* Probabilistic Graphical Models
* Design of Experiments (DOE)
* Time-Series Analysis
* Optimization Techniques
* Causal Inference
* Anomaly Detection
* Predictive Modeling
* Multivariate Statistics
* Graph Analytics

Responsibilities include:
  
  

* Creating explainable and scientifically sound models.
* Evaluating statistical significance of experimental outcomes.
* Building decision-support and autonomous reasoning systems.

**Deep Learning & Scientific AI**
Develop next-generation deep learning solutions for:
  
  

* Defect Management
* Yield Analytics
* Manufacturing Optimization
* Image Understanding
* Pattern Recognition
* Engineering Knowledge Discovery

Work with and innovate on:
  
  

* CNNs
* Vision Transformers
* Multimodal Models
* Graph Neural Networks
* Self-Supervised Learning
* Representation Learning
* Foundation Models
* Diffusion Architectures

Candidates should be comfortable reading research papers, reproducing published techniques, and identifying opportunities for improvement.
  
  
**Agentic AI & Intelligent Systems**
Develop intelligent autonomous systems capable of:
  
  

* Planning
* Reasoning
* Tool Usage
* Workflow Orchestration
* Long-Horizon Goal Achievement

Build sophisticated AI systems using:
  
  

* LangGraph
* Semantic Kernel
* AutoGen
* CrewAI
* OpenAI Agent Frameworks
* MCP (Model Context Protocol)

Examples include:
  
  

* AI Copilots
* Manufacturing Assistants
* Engineering Intelligence Platforms
* Autonomous Analytics Systems
* Knowledge Agents

**Software Engineering Excellence**
Develop production-grade solutions using:
  
  
**Primary Languages**

* Python
* Modern C++ (C++17/20)

**Additional Technologies**

* PyTorch
* Ray
* Spark
* Kubernetes
* Docker
* Vector Databases
* Graph Databases

The candidate should be able to transform research prototypes into scalable and maintainable products.
  
  
**Research Leadership Expectations**
Although this is an individual contributor role, the candidate is expected to actively contribute to building a research culture.
  
  
This includes:
  
  

* Leading technical reading groups.
* Reviewing and discussing recent research papers.
* Driving internal innovation initiatives.
* Mentoring junior engineers on research methodology.
* Promoting first-principles thinking.
* Encouraging experimentation and hypothesis-driven development.
* Establishing engineering rigor around benchmarking and evaluation.

Success is measured not only by feature delivery but also by the advancement of the team's collective technical capability.
  
  
**Required Qualifications**
**Education**
MS or PhD preferred in:
  
  

* Computer Science
* Machine Learning
* Artificial Intelligence
* Statistics
* Applied Mathematics
* Electrical Engineering
* Related STEM discipline

**Experience**
Typically:
  
  

* BS + 5 years
* OR MS + 3 years
* OR PhD

Demonstrated experience in building production AI systems while maintaining strong interest in research and innovation.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
The ideal candidate is someone who:
  
  

* Reads research papers for fun.
* Questions conventional assumptions.
* Enjoys tackling open-ended technical challenges.
* Can move seamlessly from theory to implementation.
* Has strong mathematical intuition.
* Is passionate about creating new knowledge, not merely applying existing solutions.
* Wants to become a future Principal Engineer, Distinguished Engineer, or AI Research Leader.

**What Success Looks Like After 3-5 Years**
This engineer will have:
  
  

* Become a recognized technical authority in AI and analytics.
* Influenced the AI roadmap for multiple products.
* Originated innovations that materially impact product differentiation.
* Built a thriving culture of experimentation and technical excellence.
* Mentored the next generation of AI engineers and researchers.
* Established KLA as a leader in AI-native semiconductor manufacturing intelligence.

**Minimum Qualifications**
Doctorate (Academic) Degree and 0 years related work experience; Master's Level Degree and related work experience of 3 years; Bachelor's Level Degree and related work experience of 5 years
  
  
**About KLA**
We provide advanced inspection tools, metrology systems, process solutions, and computational analytics that make electronics possible, tackling complex challenges. From electron and photon optics to machine learning and data analytics, we seek perfection at the most fundamental level of matter in the universe. If you want to make electronics that push industries forward and make the world a better place, join us.
  
  
**Use of AI Statement**
At KLA, our interviews seek to understand your individual skills, problem-solving approach and authentic thinking. To ensure a fair and consistent evaluation, the use of AI, recording tools or other technologies to generate, suggest or provide responses during interviews—whether virtual or in person—is not permitted unless explicitly approved in advance as part of a reasonable accommodation or invited by the interviewer. Use of these tools may interfere with our ability to evaluate your individual qualifications and affect your candidacy. KLA is committed to advancing innovation through responsible AI, and we value candidates who share this mindset.
  
  
*We offer a competitive, family friendly total rewards package. We design our programs to reflect our commitment to an inclusive environment, while ensuring we provide benefits that meet the diverse needs of our employees.*
*KLA is proud to be an equal opportunity employer.*

title: Associate Director, Analytical Technology
description:
Job Title: Associate Director, Analytical Technology
  
  
GCL : E
  
  
**Introduction To Role**
Are you ready to harness pioneering analytics and AI to speed medicines to patients while strengthening product quality and reliability? This role puts you at the center of shaping future analytical capabilities across biologics and ADCs—simplifying operations, elevating scientific decision-making, and enabling confident, faster technology transfers. You will act as a catalyst for innovation, turning emerging technologies and AI-enabled tools into practical solutions that improve readiness for manufacturing and strengthen control strategies across the product lifecycle.
  
  
You will lead the assessment and adoption of new analytical methods, Process Analytical Technology (PAT), and AI-enabled solutions that underpin Operations 2030 ambitions. Could you connect real-world manufacturing challenges with imaginative, compliant solutions that deliver measurable value—for example, enabling Real-Time Release Testing where justified or deploying AI tools that streamline analytical knowledge management?
  
  

* Accountabilities:

Analytical Innovation and Emerging Technologies: Lead evaluation and implementation of next-generation analytical technologies, rapid methods, and novel potency approaches to streamline control strategies while safeguarding product quality and patient safety.
  
  
Lifecycle and Technology Transfer Enablement: Assess applicability of emerging methodologies for technology transfer, commercialization, lifecycle management, comparability assessments, and post-approval changes to reduce timelines and variability.
  
  
Process Analytical Technology (PAT): Identify and implement at-line, online, inline, and rapid analytical technologies to improve process understanding and control; develop enhanced control strategies and evaluate opportunities for Real-Time Release Testing.
  
  
AI-Enabled Solutions: Build and deploy AI-assisted tools for knowledge retrieval, technical authoring, risk assessment, and decision support; establish scalable capabilities in partnership with Digital teams to drive consistency and productivity.
  
  
Operations 2030 Transformation: Lead simplification and standardization initiatives that reduce complexity and accelerate technology transfer; define metrics that demonstrate value delivered by innovation, PAT, and AI-enabled solutions.
  
  
Product Stewardship and Lifecycle Support: Provide technical leadership for analytical readiness assessments, risk assessments, comparability strategies, control strategy optimization, and long-term capability planning across the portfolio.
  
  
Change Leadership and Collaboration: Benchmark industry practices and regulatory trends, develop business cases for innovation, and drive adoption through cross-functional partnerships spanning Product Stewardship, Manufacturing Sciences, Technical Transfer, Operations, and Development.
  
  

* Essential Skills/Experience:
* Advanced degree (PhD, MS, or equivalent) in Analytical Chemistry, Biochemistry, Biotechnology, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Chemical Engineering, or related scientific subject area.
* Significant experience supporting biologics, proteins, vaccines, or ADC products.
* Deep understanding of analytical lifecycle management, technology transfer, validation, control strategies, and commercial manufacturing support.
* Demonstrated ability to lead cross-functional initiatives and drive organizational change.
* Experience supporting commercialization and lifecycle management activities.
* Desirable Skills/Experience:
* Experience with Process Analytical Technology (PAT).
* Experience evaluating and implementing innovative analytical technologies.
* Understanding of Real-Time Release Testing (RTRT) and advanced control strategies.
* Experience utilizing AI-enabled solutions in scientific or technical environments.
* Knowledge of emerging analytical and biopharmaceutical industry trends.

When we put unexpected teams in the same room, we unleash bold thinking with the power to inspire life-changing medicines. In-person working gives us the platform we need to connect, work at pace and challenge perceptions. That's why we work, on average, a minimum of three days per week from the office. But that doesn't mean we're not flexible. We balance the expectation of being in the office while respecting individual flexibility. Join us in our unique and ambitious world.
  
  

* Why AstraZeneca:

Here, your expertise has tangible impact—translating a complex, science-led pipeline into reliable supply for larger patient populations. You will collaborate with diverse experts, leverage advanced digital and automation capabilities, and contribute to ambitious goals such as decarbonizing operations and evolving toward Smart Factory practices. We value curiosity and ownership alongside kindness, giving you the space to lead, learn, and experiment while building a long-term global career with exposure to multifaceted challenges and real opportunities to shape how medicines are made.
  
  

* Call to Action:

Take the lead in defining the next generation of analytical and AI capabilities—apply today to accelerate how life-changing medicines reach patients and elevate your impact.
  
  
**Date Posted**
06-Nov-2026
  
  
**Closing Date**
19-Nov-2026
  
  
AstraZeneca embraces diversity and equality of opportunity. We are committed to building an inclusive and diverse team representing all backgrounds, with as wide a range of perspectives as possible, and harnessing industry-leading skills. We believe that the more inclusive we are, the better our work will be. We welcome and consider applications to join our team from all qualified candidates, regardless of their characteristics. We comply with all applicable laws and regulations on non-discrimination in employment (and recruitment), as well as work authorization and employment eligibility verification requirements.

This position is responsible for completing complex research on client utility accounts; is responsible for resolving bill payment edits and data, calculating and tracking billing discrepancies, in addition to working closely with other team members,utility providers, and some direct client communication. Using multiple systems, the role resolves pre-identified errors and sends consolidated bills to payment
  
  

* Key Responsibilities
* Lead and manage a high-volume Data Operations team, including Team Leads and Data Analysts, ensuring effective workload distribution and operational coverage.
* Own day-to-day operations and ensure delivery against quality, productivity, SLA, and turnaround-time targets.
* Oversee the research, analysis, validation, reconciliation, and resolution of complex data and transaction-related issues.
* Review escalated and high-impact cases, provide guidance on resolution, and ensure timely closure.

* Manage team performance through regular coaching, feedback, goal setting, and development plans.
* Identify training and skill gaps and ensure appropriate knowledge-building initiatives are implemented.
* Prepare and review operational reports, dashboards, and metrics related to productivity, quality, backlog, SLA, and issue resolution.
* Ensure effective documentation, knowledge management, and communication across the team.
* Proactively identify operational risks, dependencies, and bottlenecks and drive appropriate mitigation plans.
* Our Ideal Candidate Profile

We are looking for an experienced and analytical operations leader who can effectively manage people, processes, and stakeholder expectations in a fast-paced environment.

* 12+ years of relevant experience in data operations, data quality, analytics, billing/finance operations, or a similar domain.
* Proven experience managing teams in a high-volume, process-driven environment.
* Strong people-management and team-development skills, with experience coaching and mentoring team members.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to investigate complex issues and identify root causes.
* Excellent stakeholder and client-management skills, with the ability to handle escalations and communicate effectively with different audiences.
* Strong understanding of SLA, KPI, quality, productivity, and performance management.
* Ability to analyze operational data and convert insights into actionable improvements.
* Strong decision-making skills and the ability to manage competing priorities effectively.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Excel and operational reporting.
* Experience working with multiple systems, data sources, and cross-functional teams.
* A strong continuous-improvement mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities for process optimization and automation.
* Strong ownership, accountability, attention to detail, and customer focus.
* Ability to work effectively in a dynamic environment and adapt to changing business requirements.
* Experience with process improvement, automation, vendor management, or global stakeholder management would be an added advantage.

title: Cross Discipline - Associate Director
description:
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships – all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open – we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.
  
  
For more information, visit wppmedia.com.
  
  
****About WPP Media****
WPP is the creative transformation company. We use the power of creativity to build better futures for our people, planet, clients and communities. For more information, visit wpp.com.
  
  
WPP Media is WPP’s global media collective. In a world where media is everywhere and in everything, we bring the best platform, people, and partners together to create limitless opportunities for growth. For more information, visit wppmedia.com
  
  
At WPP Media, We Believe In The Power Of Our Culture And Our People. It’s What Elevates Us To Deliver Exceptional Experiences For Both Our Clients And Each Other. In This Role It Will Be Critical To Embrace WPP & WPP Media’s Shared Core Values:
  
  

* Be Extraordinary by Leading Collectively to Inspire transformational Creativity.
* Create an Open environment by Balancing People and Client Experiences by Cultivating Trust.
* Lead Optimistically by Championing Growth and Development to Mobilize the Enterprise.

****Role Summary And Impact****
As part of the
**Global Operations Centre (GOC)**
, you will work closely with teams across the United States, Europe, and Asia to deliver high-impact solutions in a collaborative, multicultural environment. The
**Associate Director - Cross Channel**
will lead the integration of
**eCommerce, Ad Operations, and Data Governance**
capabilities to deliver high-quality, scalable, and data-driven solutions for clients.
  
  
The role will work closely with regional, client, media, analytics, and technology teams across markets to ensure seamless campaign execution, trusted data, and strong business outcomes. The ideal candidate will combine strong knowledge of the digital and eCommerce ecosystem with operational leadership, data governance, and a passion for process improvement and innovation.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****

* Lead cross-channel operations across eCommerce, retail media, Ad Operations, and Data Governance, ensuring consistent quality and delivery across clients and markets.
* Provide strategic oversight across eCommerce and retail media platforms such as Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, Pacvue, Walmart, SKAI, DV360, CM360, IAS, Google Ads, Meta, and other emerging platforms, along with broader digital media channels.
* Ensure end-to-end campaign and data integrity from campaign setup, trafficking, tagging, and activation through data ingestion, validation, reporting, and reconciliation.
* Build and maintain governance frameworks, quality controls, and standardized processes to ensure accurate, consistent, and trusted client reporting.
* Partner with Media, Client Servicing, Analytics, Technology, and regional teams to translate business requirements into effective operational and data solutions.
* Act as a senior escalation point for complex campaign, data, reporting, and technology issues, driving root-cause resolution and clear stakeholder communication.
* Use retail and commercial understanding including promotions, pricing, inventory, margins, and consumer behaviour to inform eCommerce and media decisions.
* Drive process optimization, automation, and technology adoption, including opportunities leveraging AI and emerging marketing technologies.
* Turn campaign and business data into actionable insights, identifying opportunities to improve performance, efficiency, scalability, and client experience.
* Lead and develop high-performing teams, building strong capabilities across Commerce, Ad Operations, and Data Governance.
* Build strong relationships with senior stakeholders and contribute to client presentations, strategic initiatives, new business opportunities, and capability development.

****Required Skills & Experience****

* 8+ years of experience across eCommerce, retail media, Ad Operations, digital media, data governance, or related areas.
* Strong understanding of the digital and Commerce ecosystem, including Search, Social, Programmatic, Display, eCommerce, Retail Media, Offline, and DOOH.
* Proven experience in leading teams, managing complex client engagements, and working with global stakeholders.
* Strong understanding of eCommerce and retail media platforms such as Amazon Ads, Amazon DSP, Pacvue, Walmart, DV360, CM360, IAS, Google Ads, Meta, and similar platforms.
* Strong knowledge of campaign operations, trafficking, tracking, platform integrations, data validation, reconciliation, and reporting.
* Experience with dashboarding and data visualization tools such as Power BI, Tableau, Datorama, or similar platforms.
* Strong understanding of data governance, data quality, standardization, and single-source-of-truth principles.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated experience in process improvement, automation, and building scalable operating models.
* Strong commercial mindset with the ability to connect media, data, and operations to broader business outcomes.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, global environment with multiple priorities and stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.

****Life At WPP Media & Benefits****
Our passion for shaping the next era of media includes investing in our employees to help them do their best work, and we’re just as committed to employee growth as we are to responsible media investment. WPP Media employees can tap into the global WPP Media & WPP networks to pursue their passions, grow their networks, and learn at the cutting edge of marketing and advertising. We have a variety of employee resource groups and host frequent in-office events showcasing team wins, sharing thought leadership, and celebrating holidays and milestone events. Our benefits include competitive medical, group retirement plans, vision, and dental insurance, significant paid time off, preferential partner discounts, and employee mental health awareness days.
  
  
WPP Media is an equal opportunity employer and considers applicants for all positions without discrimination or regard to characteristics. We are committed to fostering a culture of respect in which everyone feels they belong and has the same opportunities to progress in their careers.
  
  
We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. If you require accommodations or flexibility, please discuss this with the hiring team during the interview process.
  
  
Please read our Privacy Notice for more information on how we process the information you provide.
